scripts.lint: npm run lint-scss && npm run lint-js && npm run lint-toml && npm run lint-md
scripts.validate-iiif-gnu: find docs -name manifest.json -print0 | xargs -r -0 -n1 npx eslint -c themes/projektemacher-base/eslint.config.mjs
scripts.validate-iiif-bsd: find docs -name manifest.json -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 npx eslint -c themes/projektemacher-base/eslint.config.mjs
scripts.validate-iiif: case $OSTYPE in darwin*) npm run validate-iiif-bsd ;; linux*) npm run validate-iiif-gnu ;; bsd*) npm run validate-iiif-bsd ;; *)  exit 100 ;; esac
scripts.validate-gjson: case $OSTYPE in darwin*) npm run validate-gjson-bsd ;; linux*) npm run validate-gjson-gnu ;; bsd*) npm run validate-gjson-bsd ;; *)  exit 100 ;; esac
scripts.validate: npm run validate-iiif && npm run validate-gjson
scripts.logo-monogram: svgo -i themes/projektemacher-base/static/images/cm.svg -o static/images/cm.svg && replace-in-file 'fill-opacity:.5' 'fill-opacity:1.0' static/images/cm.svg && cp static/images/cm.svg static/images/cm-black.svg
scripts.logo-monogram-black: npm run logo-monogram && replace-in-file 'fill-opacity:.5' 'fill-opacity:1.0' static/images/cm-black.svg && replace-in-file 'fill:#d40000' 'fill:#000000' static/images/cm-black.svg
scripts.logos: npm run logo-projektemacher && npm run logo-monogram-black
scripts.icons: npm run no-emoji && npm run tagcloud
scripts.svgo: npm run background && npm run icons && npm run logos
